note: Deliberate post-sync pacing edit. audio.mjs sync-durations set each frame == its voice line (88.0s total), which is too fast to read the UI and far under the brief's 4m. Approved pacing: voice + reading holds -> 125.0s (2:05). Each frame = voice duration + a settled hold at the end of the beat (action runs at frame start, hold follows the spoken line). STORYBOARD.md durations, record.mjs and slice.mjs all read these numbers.
